q1: SELECT C.DEPT_NAME, SUM(C.CREDITS) FROM COURSE AS C INNER JOIN DEPARTMENT AS D ON (C.DEPT_NAME = D.DEPT_NAME) GROUP BY C.DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(C.CREDITS) > 10 AND COUNT(DISTINCT C.CREDITS) > 5
